summary: Plug Power Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing amendments to an existing asset sale agreement and a new sale agreement with Stream US Data Centers. Under the Gateway Amendment, Plug Power will sell real property in New York for a fixed $142 million, with the outside closing extended to March 2027. The escrow deposit of ~$6.5 million plus accrued interest will be released to Plug Power, and Stream must deposit an additional $10 million for an interim closing. A separate Limestone Agreement covers the sale of Texas property for an undisclosed price. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for regulatory clearance and ability to close by March 2027.
